additional_info.subject: Error description
additional_info.body:
The StopTransaction command is triggered by the device but the charging process continues
We received a customer complaint stating that although the charging session increased the SoC from 35% to 95% SOC, the billing was calculated based on a significantly lower energy consumption.
Observed
Billed energy: 3.63 kWh
Actual delivered energy: ~56 kWh
Physical charging continued after StopTransaction
Findings (log analysis)
Device FW: v8.1.4
StartTransaction sent correctly
StopTransaction triggered by the device (no user stop request) while charging was still ongoing
Billing finalized based on StopTransaction meter values
Charging continued physically after StopTransaction
⚠️ Observed sporadically on different charger, not on every session.
This represents a risk in terms of customer trust and transparency. As a result, the customer asked whether this behavior could potentially exist across approximately 200 devices.
What exactly is the problem? We request urgent support. Is this problem a known problem?
THE LOG DATA IS AT THE ATTACHMENT... >> You can check 19:24 on the log.
Thanks in advance for your support and insights.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0476761-DC/Si-D/TR-[Multi]Physical charging continued after Stop Transaction CRM:02681001394
additional_info.body:
Hi Jagmeet,
This is not an issue limited to a single charger. We have received similar notifications from the customer for multiple devices.
The problem is not continuously reproducible; however, it is a rare but critical behavior that poses a risk to reliability and customer trust.
Below are the details of one of the reported sessions:
Charger Serial Number: 314241502027
Session Details:
Start: 12.01.2026 – 12:07
Stop (system): 12.01.2026 – 12:12
Duration: 00:05:08
Billed energy: 3.63 kWh
Observed behavior: Physical charging continued after the StopTransaction was triggered
You can find the related log data for this session in the attachment. Additionally, the charger status and behavior can be reviewed via SCB.
Please let me know if you need any further information from our side.
